scope: Frozen route contract; panels inherit server capability and device restrictions. Admin alone is not enough for raw SMS: registered gateway required.

screens.title: Home
screens.required_data: Canonical group total, today aggregate, member count, named unallocated count, recent server transactions

screens.title: Payments
screens.required_data: Scoped transactions, source payer name/time/amount/FT Id; filters and search

screens.title: Payment detail
screens.required_data: Original payer facts, full known member number distinctly labeled, source FT Id and timestamp

screens.title: Members
screens.required_data: Scoped roster with full member MoMo identifiers and authoritative balances

screens.title: Member ledger
screens.required_data: All canonical transactions and balance; full MoMo number; export

screens.title: SMS inbox
screens.required_data: Original eligible business-SIM receipts, sync states and link to canonical transaction

screens.title: Settings
screens.required_data: Signed-in operator, own passcode and support; Admin-only staff/gateway/activity

screens.title: Sign in
screens.required_data: Phone number and four-digit passcode; WhatsApp support
